label: General
title: General career development
description: Explore broad capability progressions from the example career graphic. These stages are illustrative across roles.

axes.label: Autonomy
axes.description: How independently someone can frame and carry work forward.

levels.label: Follows
levels.summary: Follows clear direction to complete bounded work.

levels.label: Collaborates
levels.summary: Collaborates with others to clarify and complete work.

levels.label: Self-Directed
levels.summary: Plans and completes work with limited guidance.

levels.label: Empowered
levels.summary: Sets a direction and makes sound decisions in a wider area.

levels.label: Visionary
levels.summary: Shapes a long-range direction that others can follow.

axes.label: Execution
axes.description: How work moves from contribution to systemic improvement.

levels.label: Contributes
levels.summary: Contributes to assigned work and shared deliverables.

levels.label: Performs
levels.summary: Performs the work reliably within an agreed scope.

levels.label: Owns
levels.summary: Owns outcomes for a piece of work from start to finish.

levels.label: Improves
levels.summary: Improves the way a team delivers results.

levels.label: Revolutionizes
levels.summary: Changes a system of work to achieve substantially better outcomes.

axes.label: Craft
axes.description: Depth of practice and ability to advance a discipline.

levels.label: Foundational
levels.summary: Builds foundational knowledge and practices the basics.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.summary: Applies the craft competently in familiar situations.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.summary: Handles complex work and explains tradeoffs to others.

levels.label: Expert
levels.summary: Provides expert guidance on difficult problems in the discipline.

levels.label: Pioneers
levels.summary: Pioneers methods or approaches that extend the discipline.

axes.label: Scope of Influence
axes.description: The breadth of people and work affected by decisions.

levels.label: Self
levels.summary: Focuses on personal work and immediate learning.

levels.label: Team
levels.summary: Influences the work and outcomes of one team.

levels.label: Multi-team
levels.summary: Coordinates or improves work across several teams.

levels.label: Company
levels.summary: Shapes decisions or practices across a company.

levels.label: Industry
levels.summary: Contributes ideas or practices with industry reach.

axes.label: People
axes.description: How someone learns with, supports, and leads other people.

levels.label: Learns
levels.summary: Learns from peers, mentors, and feedback.

levels.label: Supports
levels.summary: Supports teammates and helps shared work succeed.

levels.label: Mentors
levels.summary: Mentors others and shares useful experience.

levels.label: Coordinates
levels.summary: Coordinates people across work and resolves dependencies.

levels.label: Manages
levels.summary: Manages people or organizations toward sustained results.

axes.label: Impact
axes.description: How broadly and deliberately work creates value.

levels.label: Considers
levels.summary: Considers the effect of individual decisions.

levels.label: Comprehends
levels.summary: Comprehends how work contributes to larger goals.

levels.label: Organizes
levels.summary: Organizes work to achieve clear outcomes.

levels.label: Proactive
levels.summary: Proactively identifies opportunities for wider impact.

levels.label: Strategizes
levels.summary: Strategizes across areas to create lasting value.
